coordinates.note: Published site coordinate from the LHAASO instruments paper (peer-reviewed, read on two mirrors). It replaces a Nominatim geocode of a rest area, 5 km wide, which lay about 1.2 km away.
coordinates.quote: The Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO) (Fig. 1) is located at Mt. Haizi (4410 m a.s.l., 600 g/cm2, 29°21'27.56"N, 100°08'19.66"E) in Daocheng, Sichuan province, P.R. China.

summary.plain: The high slopes of Haizi Mountain in Daocheng County, Sichuan, China, where LHAASO's ground detectors are spread out to catch cosmic-ray and gamma-ray air showers.
summary.technical: LHAASO array site on Haizi Mountain, Daocheng County, Sichuan, China, at 4410 m altitude.
